name: ai-study-assistant-mobile
description: Nexus Study — AI Self-Study Assistant mobile app (iOS + Android)

scripts.build:android: pnpm --dir frontend-mobile exec eas build --platform android --profile production --non-interactive
scripts.build:ios: pnpm --dir frontend-mobile exec eas build --platform ios --profile production --non-interactive
scripts.submit:android: pnpm --dir frontend-mobile exec eas submit --platform android --non-interactive
scripts.submit:ios: pnpm --dir frontend-mobile exec eas submit --platform ios --non-interactive
scripts.backend:dev: cd backend && venv/bin/alembic upgrade head && venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm backend:test
scripts.backend:install: cd backend && python -m venv venv && venv/bin/python -m pip install -e '.[dev]'
